judgments.note: Scanned skill listed by folder, declared name and bare name also invoke it; manifest-path and root skills self-named. Bare-name alias of a scanned skill is untested.
Spec is silent on a plugin-local clash between a command and a skill of one command name; agent-plugins lets the command win (session-skill-entries.ts:98, oracle 2.1.319). Worth a spec sentence.

Character classes (Cc, Cf, Co, Cn, Cs, Z except one inner space, < >) and the plugin hyphen rule conform. Outside a plugin a refused frontmatter name refuses the skill instead of being unused (see 'Characters a skill name can't hold'); the 256-character limit is not applied.
agent-plugins also keeps a parenthesised group whole in `paths` (its own judgment); compatible.

The validator also reports `name must be a string`, `allowed-tools must be a string or array of strings`, a non-map `metadata` and a missing description (oracle 2.1.319); §4.10 says a wrong-type value is not reported and does not mention the description warning that J4.13 itself cites from 2.1.325. The spec text should be checked against 2.1.325 and corrected.
Probe: `name:`/blank is silent documentation, a list is skipped with an error, 3000 and true load as text.
Probe: no description gives `Agent from my-plugin plugin` (with a warning), `has:colon` and `-dash` kept.

Probe: five fields kept in file order with suggestions (maxTurn->maxTurns, Tools->tools); plugin agents too; observer is unrecognized. The words `does not recognize or apply` are the host's to log; the kit returns the list.

color magenta, isolation remote, maxTurns 0, effort huge/High/3 and background yes are dropped with a warning. But a quoted `maxTurns: "5"` (a YAML string, the wrong type) is accepted as 5, and an empty `model` is dropped without a log. Minor: either the spec should allow numeric text for maxTurns (as it does for autoCompactWindow) or the kit should drop it.
